title: 语言模型如何处理否定
summary: 研究LLM处理否定的机制：模型内部存在正确处理否定的组件，但后期注意力层会促进简单捷径导致错误答案。通过消融这些注意力模块可显著提高准确性。模型同时使用两种机制：抑制被否定概念和构建否定短语的表示，其中构建机制更为突出。
summary_en: We study how LLMs process negation mechanistically. Models possess internal components that process negation correctly, but late-layer attention promotes shortcuts causing errors. Ablating those attention modules improves accuracy. Models implement both suppressive and constructive mechanisms, with the latter being more prominent.
